item.title: KENNETH RAPOZA: Canada Has Joined Opposition To US
item.description: Unlike Mexico, Canada has been moving away from the United States since 2017, with recent realignments serving as counters to Trump. Prime Minister Mark Carney’s speech at Davos explains it all, even though he refused to name the target of his angst, which is us.
